name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Estonia says a 14 Nov arson attempt on a Tallinn drone maker was ordered by Russian military intelligence; 8 detained
state: Estonia's prime minister said an attempt to cause an explosion and fire at drone manufacturer Threod Systems in Tallinn on the night of 14 Nov was ordered by Russia's GRU; police have detained eight suspects, and nobody was hurt (Breaking Defense). Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 Dec. Analysts describe a pattern of recruited one-off agents behind sabotage across Europe (Soufan Center, 17 Nov). No sabotage causing casualties or a major outage was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Estonia's security service warns against accepting paid tasks from unknown online recruiters. If travelling to Estonia, check FCDO advice: road crossings into Russia close from 1 Dec.
rubric_hit: Watch: sabotage incident attributed to a state (Estonia attributes 14 Nov Tallinn arson attempt to Russia's GRU)

sources.title: Breaking Defense — Estonian drone company targeted in alleged Russian sabotage attempt

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
